findings.evidence:
for order in orders {
    let lines = db.lines_of_order(order.id)?;
findings.recommendation: Fetch every line in one query with the existing batch method `Db::lines_of_orders(&ids)` (`WHERE order_id = ANY($1)`, api/src/db.rs), then group the lines by `order_id` (e.g. a `HashMap<i64, i64>` of totals) and build the summaries in the order `orders_of_customer` returned, so ordering and results stay identical. As written, each customer page view runs 1 + N queries, N being the customer's order count up to 100 — up to 101 sequential round trips per request, growing with the customer's order history and multiplied by page traffic; the batch version runs 2.
findings.title: One order-lines query per order (N+1) on every customer page view
